title: docs(layout): four `layout.md` page snippets set `title` / `description` with no `pageType`, so they default to `record`, whose page leaves the heading to a `page:header` block: the copied snippet draws neither
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a published teaching error, class (c), with a measured render. `reach:` named producer: `content/docs/guide/layout.md`, four passages (Page Component › Basic Usage, With Action Buttons, Detail Page with Actions, Best Practices 3) teach a `page` node with `title` and `description` and no `pageType`. Rendered verbatim through the real `SchemaRenderer`, the Basic Usage fence draws only its child: no heading, no description. The same fence with `pageType: 'utility'` draws both. Reader who acts: triage first (grade, route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`) from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#11318 (comment `5943729479`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11421). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Mechanism (read at source by the dev; the seat did not re-measure the render)

A page with no `pageType` defaults to `record`, and `PageRenderer` leaves a `record` page's `h1` to a `page:header` block and suppresses `description` there. So a snippet that never names `pageType` is a record page whose title and description draw nothing. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11421 adds one sentence saying so under "Content Width", but the four passages above still teach the shape.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Each passage either names the `pageType` whose page draws its own heading, or moves the heading into a `page:header` block, whichever the passage is teaching. Pin: each corrected fence, rendered, draws the heading it shows.

## Dedupe
